title: VCNIA Trust Profile
description: A Trust Profile represents the accumulated trust state of a contributor, AI agent, trace, system, project, or repository within the VCNIA value circulation stack.

type.description: The fixed object type for a VCNIA trust profile.

trust_profile_id.description: A unique identifier for the trust profile.

subject_id.description: The human, AI agent, system, project, repository, trace, or contributor whose trust state is represented by this profile.

subject_type.description: The type of subject represented by this trust profile.

profile_version.description: Optional version of this trust profile.

overall_trust_score.description: Normalized overall trust score from 0.0 to 1.0.

dimensions.description: Dimension-specific trust scores. Values are normalized from 0.0 to 1.0.

originality.description: Degree of distinct or original contribution.

integrity.description: Low manipulation, abuse, or fraud risk.

citation_quality.description: Quality of citation, attribution, and reference behavior.

verification_quality.description: Strength and quality of verification signals.

network_contribution.description: Contribution to the health, stability, or intelligence of the broader network.

collaboration_quality.description: Quality of collaboration with humans, AI agents, systems, or communities.

governance_alignment.description: Alignment with stated governance principles and policies.

related_trace_ids.description: Optional list of trace records contributing to this trust profile.

related_gratitude_ids.description: Optional list of gratitude events contributing to this trust profile.

related_trust_event_ids.description: Optional list of trust events used to update or derive this trust profile.

trust_history_summary.description: Optional summary of trust history used to interpret the current profile.

total_trust_events.description: Total number of trust events associated with this profile.

positive_trust_events.description: Number of trust events that increased trust.

negative_trust_events.description: Number of trust events that decreased trust.

last_trust_event_id.description: Most recent trust event associated with this profile.

last_trust_delta.description: Most recent trust delta applied to this profile.

verification_status.description: Optional verification state of the trust profile.

profile_status.description: Optional operational status of the trust profile.

risk_flags.description: Optional list of risk signals associated with this trust profile.

decay_policy.description: Optional trust decay policy applied to this profile.

decay_enabled.description: Whether trust decay is enabled for this profile.

decay_factor.description: Decay factor applied over the defined decay interval.

decay_interval.description: Interval at which trust decay may be applied.

last_decay_at.description: Optional timestamp of the last decay application.

decay_reason.description: Optional explanation of the decay policy.

recovery_policy.description: Optional trust recovery policy for the subject.

recovery_enabled.description: Whether trust recovery is supported for this profile.

recovery_conditions.description: Conditions that may allow trust recovery.

recovery_notes.description: Optional notes describing trust recovery rules.

governance_ref.description: Optional reference to the governance policy used to calculate or maintain this trust profile.

policy_uri.description: Optional URI pointing to the governance policy.

audit.description: Optional audit information for this trust profile.

created_by.description: Entity that created this trust profile.

updated_by.description: Entity that last updated this trust profile.

review_required.description: Whether human or governance review is required.

review_notes.description: Optional notes from review or audit.

created_at.description: Optional time when the trust profile was created.

updated_at.description: The time when the trust profile was last updated, expressed in ISO 8601 date-time format.

context.description: Optional contextual information about the project, workflow, system, or community in which this trust profile is used.
